Private Function Try(ByVal s As String) As String
Dim r As String
r = IIf(IsDate(s), "T", "F") & "|"
On Error Resume Next
Dim d As Date
d = CDate(s)
If Err.Number Then r = r & "e" & Err.Number Else r = r & Format(d, "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss")
Try = r
End Function
